research_question: Can a task-level privileged planning response reduce the natural pedestrian near-miss severity on finite Route147 while preserving full route completion and bounded delay?

scientific_role.clean: Current-code matched baseline with Density hard-disabled and no learned adapter.
scientific_role.oracle: Planning-mechanism upper bound using privileged walker occupancy; no uncertainty model is evaluated.
scientific_role.claim_boundary: A pass unlocks Stage2 training but does not demonstrate learned-adapter efficacy, uncertainty semantics, or a collision reduction.

frozen_planning_response.trajectory_contract: Clamp progress along ORION's unmodified path in prepare/hold, creep during release, and exactly preserve the unmodified ORION plan in go.

success_thresholds.logic: all_required; walker minimum TTC may be right-censored as safe if no finite collision TTC occurs

pipeline_contract.legacy_density_uq: hard_disabled; every new trace frame must have density_uq_score=null
pipeline_contract.new_spatial_adapter: absent from both mechanism conditions; every frame must have observation_uq=null
pipeline_contract.scalar_risk_governor: off and exact control passthrough in both conditions
pipeline_contract.stage2_target_source: privileged actor occupancy crossed with the unmodified ORION candidate trajectory; never Density, corruption identity, or adapter output

offline_evidence.historical_density_note: The 1082515 clean source predates Density retirement and passively logged scores under risk_mode=off. It is used only for offline mechanism feasibility. Both newly authorized runs must log zero non-null Density frames.

single_pair_rule.resubmission: forbidden without a timestamped amendment explaining a runtime-environment failure

stage2_unlock_rule.failure_action: Keep Stage2 locked, diagnose the pair, and do not substitute Density UQ or a scalar governor.
